name: Untitled
purpose: Icon options for selection; not yet installed as the application icon

variants.label: A · Open Frame / 留白
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a polished macOS application icon exploration for a software brand named Untitled. The software is freely customizable with agent-built plugins. The brand idea is an open canvas whose purpose is defined by its owner.
Style: extremely restrained Swiss graphic design; flat vector-like bitmap; assertive balanced geometry; large negative spaces; simple enough to identify at 16 pixels.
Output one icon on an exact square 1024x1024 canvas, the solid background fills the entire canvas edge to edge. Optical safe margin around the central mark is 22 percent. No scene or mockup.
Palette: pure black #000000 and pure white #FFFFFF only, with natural edge antialiasing. Absolutely no accent colors, gray fills, shading, shadows, gradients, texture, grain, reflections or 3D.
Avoid all house, roof, door, nest or home imagery. No robots, tools, gears, stars, sparkles, circuitry, explanatory text, labels, wordmark or watermarks. This is an app symbol, not an illustration or a title card.
Composition: white background. The symbol is an incomplete thick black square frame with subtly rounded corners, with a generous clean opening at its upper right corner. A small solid black square floats within the opening, separated from both frame ends by equal clear gaps. The composition suggests an unclaimed blank canvas and a piece that can be added. Very simple, quiet and balanced. Do not draw a roof, diagonal slash or viewfinder crop markers. Use one continuous frame plus one detached square, and keep the central white square perfectly empty.
